Prem Dev View (PremDevView) — Free Local Host Mobile Preview Tool

Prem Dev View (also searched as premdev view, premdevview, or PremDevView) is a free web developer tool created and engineered by Prem Sagar Pandey. It provides an authentic local host mobile preview for un-deployed web projects and development servers (localhost:3000, localhost:5173, 127.0.0.1:5500) inside an authentic virtual smartphone frame with live hot reload, landscape rotation, and zero configuration.

How to Preview Localhost on Phone with PremDevView

  1. Step 1: Start your local development server (e.g. npm run dev, npm start, or VS Code Live Server).
  2. Step 2: Copy your local URL or port (such as http://localhost:5173, localhost:3000, or port 5500).
  3. Step 3: Open PremDevView at https://prem-dev-view.vercel.app/, paste your address, and click 'Open Mobile Preview'.
  4. Step 4: Interact with your project inside a realistic smartphone screen with live hot reload.

Key Features

  • Direct localhost streaming (port 3000, 5173, 5500, 8080)
  • Hardware-accelerated portrait and landscape rotation
  • 100% Client-side privacy: runs entirely in the browser
  • Accurate mobile phone bezel and viewport simulation
